description: ENS on Ethereum: a .eth name to its address, or an address to its primary ENS name, forward-verified so a reverse record pointing elsewhere is never returned. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

address.description: an address to look up its ENS name

name.description: an ENS name such as vitalik.eth (pass name OR address)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: ens_resolve
